title: Pendulums are the most common artifact in Egypt

tellings.quote: If you go to Egypt and you dig in the soil there, the most artifacts that they find under the ground in Egypt are pendulums.

plain: Pendulums are the artifact found most often when people dig in the soil of Egypt. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him and whom NASA has studied, tells Michels this and credits a man named Robert Gilbert. If true, it would hint that the ancient Egyptians had some special use for pendulums.
